summary: Run the tests of the mutated file's directory. Derive the package import path from the module path and the module-relative directory of the file, and remove the package-declaration-name heuristic. Map internal/engine in the Ground Control architecture modules.
trust_boundaries: The engine computes the package path from the module path and the walked file path in memory. The executor keeps its existing go test command with a different package argument. A regression test runs go test on a temporary module without dependencies. No package dependency, CLI flag, configuration key, report field, exit code, or network destination changes. The .ground-control.yaml change adds an architecture module mapping for design context only; it changes no workflow command or gate.
